fusions.name: Tail-Sweep Flick
fusions.desc: Sweeps the lash across a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Strike
fusions.desc: After lying still, you lash an enemy up to 7 tiles away for 32 damage, up to 1.4 times that at maximum range, and it always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Shed and Regrow
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun on the Scales
fusions.desc: In daylight, your damage rises by 10%.
